distribution.summary: 黑龙江；吉林；辽宁；北京；河北；山东；河南；陕西；宁夏；甘肃；江苏
distribution.narrative: EF1984 reports 黑龙江（哈尔滨），吉林（公主岭），辽宁（熊岳，旅大），北京，河北（秦皇岛，昌黎），山东（青岛），河南（安阳），陕西（西安，武功），宁夏（贺兰山），甘肃（肃南），江苏（南京）. CO2015 reports 黑龙江，吉林，辽宁，北京，河北，山东，河南，陕西，宁夏，甘肃，江苏. Published geographic evidence only; original regional occurrence assessment remains unchanged and requires separate review.

host_note: Host names reported by cited sources, not independently confirmed. The regional occurrence assessment is not changed. The noted Chinese-name discrepancy for Prunus persica does not change the published scientific host name.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus emarginatus (Wichmann, 1915).
